body.p: , after , , , , , , . src/xslt_lower.c, src/xslt_lower_construct.c, src/xslt_simple_content.c with src/xslt_lower_internal.h; no IR kind, no evaluator change, no public header.

item.p: One machine: XSLT instructions are lowering procedures pushed with sxml_xpath_lowering_push_procedure () on a lowerer of language XSLT; every expression and value template goes through the embedding entry with an XPath static context made once per AST static context (namespaces, xpath-default-namespace as prefix 0, base URI, the processor's function table). The files define no lowering part (no XPath AST kind is XSLT's yet); instructions are found through sxml_xslt_instruction_rule views, one per file, listed in src/xslt_lower.c (4.7 to 4.14 add a view and one line).

Sequence constructor = one atom per child, bound in the caller's block; its value is the SEQUENCE of them, given to constructors as one ATOM content (: one enclosed expression, so 5.7.1 joins adjacent atomic values across instructions). Variables a child pushes stay in scope until the constructor ends (4.7's xsl:variable). A constructor call may install a focus (FIXED for xsl:copy select, SLOTS for the for-each of xsl:array).

Literal result elements: ELEMENT_CONSTRUCTOR with XSLT_RULES, an xs:QName constant, namespace bindings from the stylesheet tree's in-scope namespaces minus xml, the excluded namespaces (unless an alias outputs them) and alias literal URIs (11.1.3, 11.1.4; aliases resolved by import precedence, XTSE0810); xsl:inherit-namespaces="no" is NO_INHERIT. Attributes are ATTRIBUTE_CONSTRUCTORs of their AVT.

Value templates and simple content (5.6, 5.7.2): string templates lowered here; each enclosed value goes through the internal native row merge-text-nodes (adjacent text nodes to one xs:untypedAtomic, else the value as it is) and fn:string-join. Fixes 's deviation: {//item/text()} is "onetwo". The same path gives xsl:attribute, xsl:value-of, xsl:text, xsl:comment (hyphens fixed with fn:replace, 11.8), xsl:processing-instruction (leading space, "?>", 11.6) and xsl:namespace (XTDE0930) their strings.

Names: a name (and namespace) without enclosed expressions is resolved while lowering to an xs:QName constant; an invalid one becomes a RAISE of XTDE0820/0830/0850/0855/0860 when evaluated. A computed name is a string resolved by the evaluator with the instruction's in-scope namespaces as name_namespaces (without the default one for attributes), or fn:QName(namespace, name) (prefix dropped for "").

XSLT error codes where the evaluator raises XQuery's: a TRY_CATCH around the constructor alone whose clauses RAISE the XSLT code (sxml_xslt_lowering_bind_mapped_expression): XQDY0137 to XTDE3365, XPTY0004 to XTTE3375 (maps), XQDY0074/0044/FOCA0002 to XTDE08x0 (names), XQDY0041/0064 to XTDE0890, XQDY0074/0101 to XTDE0920/0925.

Others: xsl:copy is SHALLOW_COPY with the content as its own body; xsl:copy-of a MAP that SHALLOW_COPYs elements and documents with (@*, node()) as content and other nodes whole; xsl:map/xsl:record a MAP_CONSTRUCTOR (fields, then the content's maps as a merged entry), with [xsl:]duplicates map:merge; xsl:array array:of-members over JNodes (fn:jtree for non-JNodes), xsl:array-member fn:jtree; xsl:select its content expression; extension and unknown instructions their xsl:fallback children or XTDE1450.

Stylesheet AST (accepts 's Proposed item): appended SXML_XSLT_AST_KIND_RECORD and attribute kinds CONSTRUCTOR (record-type, BOOLEAN) and RECORD_FIELD (EXPRESSION); xsl:record reads attributes in no namespace as fields (no shadow or standard attributes), xsl:-prefixed ones as standard attributes and xsl:duplicates.

Entry (until 4.8 and 4.15): sxml_xslt_lower_initial_template lowers one template's sequence constructor as the main function (focus = global context item), optionally inside a DOCUMENT constructor (the principal result tree), then runs the standard passes and seals.
Deviations: xpath-default-namespace="##any" reads as none; attribute sets (4.12), xsl:type/validation ignored (); a zero-length text node is no node ().
